selection: Independently maximize each metric for each model/method/target on the evaluated standard grid, then take the unweighted target mean. Selection is on the evaluation set.
tie_break: Lower strength, then lower zero-based layer, then configuration ID.

if_avg.label: Instruction following
if_avg.meaning: Rule satisfaction, coherence and adequate answer jointly succeed.

tool_followup.label: Single-turn follow-up
tool_followup.meaning: The initial decision and follow-up action both succeed for the same item.

tool_multi.label: Multi-turn BFCL
tool_multi.meaning: BFCL execution and irrelevance checks; the field matching the published main table.

tool_multi_joint.label: Multi-turn joint success
tool_multi_joint.meaning: BFCL checks combined with semantic decision checks; a distinct metric from tool_multi.

null: Not applicable or not evaluated; do not render as zero.
